title: Transfer of Land
text:
The full address of all the new owners of the property (called the transferee(s)). 
The name and address of the person(s) who will witness the transferor(s) signature(s). 
A Foreign Ownership of Land declaration, if required (i.e. when the property is NOT located in a city, town, village, or 
summer village). 
Additional forms 
If dower requirements apply; if there is only one current owner on the property, you will need one of the following: 
x Consent and Acknowledgement by Spouse, or 
x Dower Affidavit, or 
x Release of Dower Rights and Affidavit in Support of Dower Release, or 
x Court Order Dispensing with Dower, or 
x Statement in the Affidavit Re Value of Land that the transfer is from the married person to the married person and 
their spouse (only when adding the spouse to the title) or 
x Only one of the owners is transferring his/her interest 
Important information 
If the transfer of land is being completed by a personal representative of an estate, such as an Executor or 
Administrator, it will also require a completed Affidavit of Minors for Estates form.
